description: This file implements the main React component for a multi-column interactive to-do board with drag-and-drop functionality, localStorage persistence, and task management features.

methods.name: safeParseBoard
methods.description: Parses a JSON string from localStorage into the BoardData structure, with validation and fallback.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Moves a task from one column to another within the board data structure.

methods.name: createId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for new tasks.
